reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for append-only, timestamped agent memory with hierarchical summaries, bounded context injection, retrieval tools, source tracing, and a visual memory panel.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于工作区文件的时间轴记忆、分层摘要、记忆检索、上下文注入和可视化看板。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with workspace-based timeline memory, hierarchical summaries, memory retrieval, context injection, and a visual memory panel.

capabilities: Appends and maintains timestamped memory facts in workspace-local files
Generates hierarchical summaries of stored facts
Retrieves, expands, and opens stored memories and their source content
Injects a bounded memory view into agent session context
Provides a visual memory panel with timeline and hierarchy views
Supports forgetting and rebuilding summary nodes without deleting source facts
